svg.text: A round board that the existing modules solder onto, replacing the breadboard. Drawn to scale; module sizes approximate. Not a manufacturable design.
module on headers, glass ≈ Ø36 mm
no copper under the ESP32 antenna
USB-C at the edge: power + flashing
Open decisions before a real layout

1. GPS antenna: a patch must face the sky with no ground plane above it. On the back it faces the ground when the radar is held face-up. Options: a bigger board with the patch on the front, an active antenna, or a ceramic chip antenna.
2. Power: the prototype runs only from USB. A LiPo cell and charger would not fit beside the modules; it would sit under the board in the enclosure.
3. Compass: keep it away from a battery, a speaker and high-current traces, or recalibrate with them in place.
